title: CLAUDE.md MSRV says 1.75 for mime-tree but Cargo.toml says 1.85
description: CLAUDE.md line 55 states 'MSRV: 1.75 (mime-tree), 1.85 (smime-tree)'. mime-tree/Cargo.toml rust-version = '1.85'. README.md correctly says both 1.85. Stale doc misleads agents into testing wrong toolchain. Fix: update CLAUDE.md to 1.85 for mime-tree.
